news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results August 3, 2026
news.source: The Globe and Mail / ACCESS Newswire
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro confirmed it will report second-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on August 3, 2026, followed by a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro CEO Burnett sells $387,600 in company shares
news.summary: A Form 4 filing disclosed that CEO Joseph Burnett sold approximately $387,600 worth of ClearPoint Neuro common stock in early July 2026, coinciding with a pullback in the shares that day.

news.headline: Stifel reiterates Clearpoint Neuro stock Buy rating, $16 price target on neurosurgery platform
news.summary: Stifel reiterated its Buy rating and $16 price target on ClearPoint Neuro following the biennial American Society for Stereotactic and Functional Neurosurgery (ASSFN) meeting, citing continued traction for the company's neurosurgical navigation platform.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro reports second-quarter 2026 results after market close with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET; investors will watch for progress toward full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $52M-$56M.

catalysts.label: Partner pipeline milestones
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's device/navigation revenue is tied to biopharma partners' gene- and cell-therapy programs (e.g., uniQure's AMT-130) that use its SmartFlow and navigation systems; regulatory or clinical progress at these partners is a recurring catalyst for ClearPoint's IRRA flow and per-case revenue.

catalysts.label: Continued Velocity Alpha and international rollout
catalysts.detail: Following FDA clearance and CE marking of the Velocity Alpha MR surgical drill system earlier in 2026, further commercial rollout and international regulatory clearances remain an ongoing growth driver.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro heads into its August 3, 2026 Q2 print on the back of a strong Q1 (revenue up 43% overall, 16% organically, to $12.1M) and reaffirmed FY2026 guidance of $52M-$56M, with the IRRAS acquisition now contributing IRRA flow revenue and recent product wins (Velocity Alpha drill FDA clearance/CE mark, PRISM 1.5T MRI clearance) expanding its addressable market. Sell-side sentiment remains constructive (Stifel reiterated Buy/$16 in June), though the stock has been choppy and saw routine insider selling by the CEO in early July. The core investment case still hinges on ClearPoint's role as the neuro-navigation and delivery-device partner for gene- and cell-therapy developers, making partner clinical/regulatory progress as important a catalyst as ClearPoint's own device revenue growth.
